status: Resolved Compose-first Ripple source selection and owner-approved browser interpolation limits; native acceptance pending.

compose.reason: Pinned animation source and source-value browser render; native raster comparison remains pending.

decisions.reason: Pinned Compose Ripple covers bounded and unbounded geometry with the 10% pressed state layer.
Pinned Compose press tweens govern 75ms alpha, 225ms radius and center, 150ms exit, and finish interruption.
Pinned Compose Ripple state layer uses 15ms hover/focus exit, 45ms focus/drag entry, 150ms drag exit and current-alpha retargeting.
Native browser pointer and keyboard events govern event delivery to the visual indication.
